newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks slip in lightly bid market.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks slip in lightly bid market.

text.p: Caracas share prices slipped in a lightly bid market, traders said, with low volume an indication of little foreign interest.
"Because there were few buyers, sellers had to drop their prices," said Intervalores broker Ricardo Marino.
The bolsa's 19-share index slipped 2.12 percent to close at 5,834.64, as 14 million shares traded worth 2.4 billion bolivars ($5 million).
Bellwether stock Electricidad de Caracas led the dropl losing 17.50 bolivars to close at 513.50. Among traded issues, 30 fell, four rose and none closed flat.
Among the day's other major trades, Consolidada Carabobo first and second share series and lost 15.00 and 20.00 bolivars respectively to end at 490.00 and 480.00.
Foods company Mavesa also closed off 4.00 bolivars at 147.00, while steel company Sivensa dropped 8.50 bolivars to end at 366.00.
